== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Officer Evax (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Officer Evax]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100661 source], Japanese ESB Two-Player photograph.

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>a056dd6356d3a7cb0e150d8f038d0dc9cc8cd3c53b43e3d0e8dea6f8f503f7d5</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
